name: Agave Nectar
siboNotes: High in excess fructose which feeds bacteria in SIBO. Use sparingly and only during symptom-free periods if tolerated.
preparationTips: Use only small amounts (1/2 tablespoon or less) if testing tolerance
Dilute with water when using in beverages to reduce concentration
Pair with glucose-containing foods to improve fructose absorption
Start with even smaller amounts (1 teaspoon) when first testing
nutritionalHighlights: Lower glycemic index than table sugar
Contains trace minerals like calcium and potassium
